section_summary.extract_value: This section describes Study 1, which examined the factor structure and psychometric properties of a Malay translation of the BAS-2 in Malaysian adults. The study aimed to assess measurement invariance across gender (women and men) and major ethnic groups (Malaysian Malays and Malaysian Chinese), and to examine construct validity through correlations with well-being measures, body image measures, media influence perceptions, and self-reported BMI. The researchers expected BAS-2 scores to reduce to a single dimension and achieve full measurement invariance across sex and ethnic groups, with significant negative correlations between BAS-2 and self-reported BMI.
